entities.name: Jovana Preković
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jovana Preković is a Serbian former karateka competing in kumite -61 kg division. She is a two-time world champion in the women's kumite 61 kg event and the 2020 Olympic champion, in karate's lone appearance as a Summer Olympic sport.
